decision_conditions: The proposed development by virtue of its siting and appearance would result in an incongruous addition to the streetscene that would be visually intrusive. Furthermore, it has not been demonstrated that the proposal would not result in a proliferation of such infrastructure that would have a cumulative detrimental impact on the character and appearance of the area and the Manor Park Local Open Space, contrary to Paragraphs 120 of the National Planning Policy Framework 2024, Policies D3 of the London Plan DM5 and DM10 of the Council's adopted LDF Core Strategy April 2012.

The applicant has failed to demonstrate that the proposal would not harm the health and longevity of the immediately adjacent street tree, which would have an unacceptable adverse impact on the quality of the public realm within Malden Road and the character and appearance of the street and the wider area, thereby conflicting with the National Planning Policy Framework 2024, Policies G7 and D3 of the London Plan 2021 and DM5 and DM10 of the Council's adopted LDF Core Strategy April 2012.
description: Installation of a telecommunications base station comprising a 17.5m monopole supporting 6 no antennas, 2 no dishes, together with 2 no ground based cabinets and ancillary development thereto.
